Solid baseline banked: excitement **0.6**, intensity 0.33, no crash. Now let me build something much better with inversions. Let me start fresh and build the lift, then explore inversion options interactively.
Vertical loop isn't offered here, but corkscrews are. Let me place a corkscrew inversion and inspect what follows.
Two inversions placed (S-corkscrew). Now at (50,47,128,dir0). Let me build the return leg to close the circuit back to the station.

Excellent — excitement **5.26**, intensity 4.81, similarity 0.48 (no penalty), 1 inversion. Big jump. Let me try to improve by adding an airtime hill at the high-speed point. Rebuilding.
Improved to **5.34** with tripled air time, banked. Intensity is only 4.86 — lots of headroom. Let me add a second inversion (a mirrored corkscrew) for more excitement.
One flat short. Adding one more.

Excitement **5.54** with 2 inversions, banked. Intensity only 4.92 — big headroom. The drop is small (highest_drop 12). Since the drop always ends at the same point regardless of lift height, I can safely make the lift much taller for a bigger drop and more speed. Let me try a taller lift.
Excitement **5.62**, intensity 5.59, drop 18, similarity down to 0.435. Banked. Let me add a bigger airtime hill at the high-speed point after the drop.

Excitement **5.76**, air time doubled to 39. Airtime clearly helps. Let me try a sharp 60° airtime hill at max speed right after the main drop for stronger negative-G.
Excitement **5.89**, negative-G -2.22 (strong ejector airtime), intensity 6.6 with headroom. Let me add a second sharp airtime hill in the fast zone.
At (38,45) as planned. Closing with 3 airtime hops (12 tiles).
Broke past **6.03**, air time 66. Airtime is the key lever. Let me add a third sharp hill in the fast zone.
Excitement **6.10**, air time 93, similarity 0.36. Let me try boosting inversions — adding two more corkscrews (4 total) as a cancelling pair.
All 4 corkscrews accepted. At (28,45), closing with 5 hops + 2 flats (22 tiles).

Excitement **6.42** with 4 inversions, intensity 7.88 (still under 10), air time 105. Let me make the return hills sharp too — the return runs at ground level (fastest point) so it can support ejector airtime.
Excitement plateaued at ~6.42 (airtime saturated), though similarity improved. My best remains 6.42. Let me try one more lever — a taller first drop for more speed — building on the v11 layout.
New best: excitement **6.50**, intensity 8.31, 4 inversions, highest drop 24. Let me confirm the banked best result.

My best is locked in at **excitement 6.50**. 

I progressed from a simple 0.6 oval to a strong twister by iterating on the levers that mattered: a 200ft chain-lift first drop, a triple-sharp-60° ejector-airtime run, **four corkscrew inversions** (alternating pairs so they cancel laterally), and a fast ground-level bunny-hop return. Intensity sits at a safe 8.31 (well under the 10 cliff), nausea 4.48, and similarity is only 0.35 — original enough to avoid any penalty.

**Best coaster: an original steel twister with 4 inversions, a 24-unit first drop, 97 air-time, and 13 drops — banked at excitement 6.50** (intensity 8.31, no crash).
